name: speedygo-dev-review-catalog
purpose: Synthetic development catalog for Customer app visual review through the real API. Not production. Does not impersonate real businesses or use real logos.

namespace.idempotency: INSERT … ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING. Re-run does not duplicate or UPDATE/DELETE rows outside this namespace.
doesNotOwn: DEMO SpeedyGo Cover Cafe / DEMO Cover Hydra
live accounts +213549445167, +213550667788 and other pre-existing users

owner.roles: OWNER of the 10 review merchants only

apiReviewer.purpose: Optional Customer API reads. Never used to automate the live Simulator session.

hoursCases.runtimeChecks: Checkout/order still enforce hoursConfigured and isOpenNow. This fixture does not bypass those checks.

documentedClosed.behavior: Schedule row exists, zero intervals → hoursConfigured=true, always closed

productImages.coverage: Only products with a matching licensed photograph in ASSET_MANIFEST.json products[]. Remaining review-catalog SKUs stay without an image.
productImages.doNot: A branch cover must not masquerade as a product photograph. Flutter must not hardcode product-to-image maps.

paginationLimitation: Ten new storefronts plus two existing demos is well under the default 50-item page. Live pagination of a full page is not claimed. Keep existing catalog_pagination_test.dart.
